_comment: WHAT EXISTS in a furnished room (content sets GEN-2): two terrain kinds, a rug you walk over and a pillar you walk around. Both say `generate: true`, so a world that names this pack under "what exists" (`params.exists`) lets the "Randomly placed tiles" maze biome place them, only where the room's logic stays exactly as it was. Never offered by a theme (⚖ Q4).
